title: Preset — Workspace Bootstrap
description: Generate the root workspace skeleton: config files, repo infrastructure (via :infra), AI-assistant instructions (via :llm).

npmScope.description: npm scope used in package names (e.g. 'mouryaamit' → '@mouryaamit/...').

baseBranch.description: Default base branch for Nx affected and CI workflows.

apps.description: Comma-separated app types to seed (e.g. 'angular,flutter'). Phase 3: stored in nx.json tags only.

ci.description: Comma-separated CI providers for the :infra ci part. Supported: github-actions, jenkins.

infra.description: Run :infra with these parts: docs, ci, quality, upgrades (comma-separated), all, or none.

ciCache.description: :infra — GitHub Actions: cache the Nx cache directory.

flutter.description: :infra — set up Flutter in CI: auto (when the workspace has Flutter projects), on, off.

llm.description: Comma-separated AI-assistant instruction files, written by the :llm generator: claude (CLAUDE.md), agents (AGENTS.md), copilot (.github/copilot-instructions.md). codex and openai-gpt are aliases for agents.

projectDescription.description: Short description written into root package.json.

lintCommand.description: Lint command for the package.json lint script (a command that runs the lint script itself is replaced by nx run-many -t lint).

skipFormat.description: Skip formatFiles call (useful in automated pipelines).

angular.description: Angular major to add to the workspace now. Without it, the first Angular or Ionic app adds Angular 15.

pluginVersion.description: nx-polystack version to pin in the generated package.json (default: the running plugin's version).
